note: Built from data/roots/verbs.json (itself copied from data/vocab/words.json). Kept: verbs with needsReview false, level A1 or A2, all three listed forms (infinitive, present, future), three different forms, an infinitive starting with lamed and a future starting with yod (the "he will" form). Verbs with any form spelled like the four-letter divine name are left out. Fields are copied unchanged. Which person and gender the present form is was not marked in the source; it is the dictionary present (masculine singular). Not reviewed by a teacher.
